scope: Current loaded positive Daedalus half-wing, prescribed physical root motion, live offset brace and real mass; fixed body-axis nodal aerodynamic/gravity loads.
reference: Independent continuous spatial rod and real-mass equations; second-derivative SEGSPL interpolation; independent nonlinear equilibrium under the same dead loads and root pose.
motion_metric: For each frequency/input, max absolute difference in [displacement/56, spatial rotation] across all nodes divided by the reference maximum absolute value. No denominator floor.
reaction_metric: For each frequency/input, max absolute difference in [force, moment/56] divided by the reference maximum absolute value. No denominator floor.
derived_diagnostic: Apply the supplied full-aircraft complex wing-root motion to both component response maps. This is not an additional independent test case or the complete aircraft response.
interpretation: Coarse-grid failure requires examination/refinement, not changes to tolerance or physics parameters. Agreement supports only this disclosed component formulation; ISAE fractions and full-aircraft Bode validation remain separate.
